tooltipHeaderText.description:
Optional hard-coded tooltip header text to render for the map markers. If provided, this text will render as the
tooltip header for _all_ markers on the map.

tooltipHeaderField.description:
Optional reference to a field to use as the tooltip header text to render for the map markers. For each data point,
the value of the field will be used as the header text. If a #tooltipHeaderText is provided, it will be
rendered instead.

tooltipSubHeaderText.description:
Optional hard-coded tooltip sub-header text to render for the map markers. If provided, this text will render as
the tooltip header for _all_ markers on the map.

tooltipSubHeaderField.description:
Optional reference to a field to use as the tooltip sub-header text to render for the map markers. For each data
point, the value of the field will be used as the sub-header text. If a #tooltipSubHeaderText is provided,
it will be rendered instead.

tooltipAdditionalFields.description:
Optional references to additional fields to render in the map marker tooltips. For each data point, the values of
these fields will be appended to the map marker tooltip.

title: Configuration for the tooltips that render on click of each map marker.
name: GenAiUiMapTooltipConfig
